facts.headline: World Cup Faces Air Quality Disaster as Wildfires Threaten Host Cities in Water Scarcity Cities
facts.summary: The World Cup is at risk of air quality disasters due to wildfires in water scarcity cities. This collapse in air quality reflects a deeper crisis: climate volatility is unraveling global events. The illusion of stable environmental conditions is breaking—one wildfire, one policy, at a time, in water scarcity cities.
